body:
1) ramguard.lua (cb29e7b): word addressing only for data_width 16 with address shift -1; refuse other shifts; word spaces drop later non-RAM overlays.
2) dump.lua (3bbd256): mask defaults were 0xff, now every bit read.
3) SDL_MAC_BACKGROUND_APP=1 on every MAME run (5435b15): MAME took focus even with -video none.
4) pre-push gitleaks --log-opts trailing-space bug (f044d38).
summary: Four items worth taking: ramguard word spaces, dump.lua mask defaults, SDL_MAC_BACKGROUND_APP=1, gitleaks pre-push fix
